narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are seven pieces on the table, so that makes seven whole sheets.
<bookmark mark='fill'/>Lay the pieces on seven whole sheets, and half of the space stays empty.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Each piece is only half a sheet, so seven pieces make far fewer sheets.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, cut the three whole sheets back into halves and count them.
<bookmark mark='sum'/>Three wholes are six halves, and one more half makes seven halves again.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: 3 wholes = 6 halves, and 6 halves + 1 half = 7 halves

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu counts seven pieces and says there are seven whole sheets. Each piece is only half a sheet, so seven pieces cannot make seven sheets, and the bubble is struck.
